headline: One picture, 3 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 3 different works in 3 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 3 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.000 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 51e34f451455 on 2 works, 53c029d50288 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Bore-Well Recharge (2), Other (1).
The entries were made by 2 different offices: BDPO Arniwala, ziledar kabulshah.
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Arniwala Shiekh Subhan, Fazilka.
